title: Karur stampede: DMK withdraws plea against CM Vijay, TVK after Supreme Court says.....
description: The Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (DMK) on Tuesday withdrew its plea seeking impleadment in the case pending before the Supreme Court concerning the Karur stampede during a 2025 Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) rally, which had led to 41 deaths and injured several others.
